name: Summernight Powerslam

date.source: The show's own posted dateline; a follow-up broadcast two days later refers back to 'last week's card.'

matches.title: wfw-1995-usenet-intercontinental
matches.finish: Inferno won by count-out to become the first-ever WFW Intercontinental Champion.
matches.stipulation: WFW Intercontinental Championship — final of a battle-royal-qualified tournament, unlike a normal title match

matches.title: wfw-1995-usenet-world-heavyweight
matches.finish: The Ultimate Fighting Machine pinned champion Johnny Banger to win the WFW World Championship.

notes: WFW's own first supercard, introducing two new titles (the Intercontinental Championship, decided by a battle-royal-qualified final; the World Tag Team Championship, won by the Skyhawks, not structured for lack of a recovered opponent team) and changing hands on the World Championship. Posted to the newsgroup on the fed operator's own behalf by a second community member.
